why.d: Every piece is designed with intent: world-class aesthetics in service of conversion.
Clean code, loading speed and automation. No slow templates.
We work with data and metrics, not promises. Every project has clear goals.
Direct communication with the people doing the work. No middlemen, no canned replies.

services.title: Everything your brand needs to grow
services.intro: We don't start with the tool, we start with the goal: more clients, more sales, more brand. Then we pick the path.

faq.q: How much does a website cost?
faq.a: It depends on scope: a landing page starts at roughly $120.000 CLP and a corporate site or e-commerce is quoted based on features. You always get a fixed price before we start.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: A landing page takes 1–2 weeks; a corporate site, 3–5 weeks; an e-commerce, 4–8 weeks. We give you a clear timeline at kickoff.

faq.q: Do you include support and maintenance?
faq.a: Yes. Every project includes a post-launch support period, and we offer monthly maintenance plans: backups, security, updates and minor changes.

faq.q: How many design revisions are included?
faq.a: We work with defined revision rounds (usually 2–3 per stage) to move fast without losing quality. Your feedback is part of the process, not an extra.

faq.q: Do you work with clients outside Santiago?
faq.a: Yes, we work 100% remotely with clients across Chile and abroad. Meetings happen over video calls and day-to-day communication over WhatsApp.

about.title: Technology and advertising, working together
about.manifesto: BrandUp was born from a simple conviction: a brand grows when design, technology and strategy pull in the same direction. We're not a website factory or a smoke-and-mirrors agency. We're a small, senior team obsessed with making every peso you invest show up in your business.

diego.name: Diego Gutiérrez
diego.bio: Computer science engineer. He leads web development, e-commerce and the technology layer of every project: performance, automation and integrations.

valentina.name: Valentina
valentina.bio: Advertising professional and content creator. She leads branding, creative direction, content and strategy: the visible face of the brands we build.

values.d: We explain what we do and why, in plain language. Decisions are made with information, not technicalities.
We'd rather take on fewer projects and make them impeccable. Your brand is our portfolio.
We measure everything we do. If something doesn't work, we change it fast.

about.processTitle: How we take your project from brief to launch

process.d: We understand your business, your clients and your goals. We audit your current presence and define what success means for you.
We define the plan: scope, messaging, architecture and metrics. You receive a concrete proposal with timeline and a fixed price.
We create the visual concept and iterate it with you through defined revision rounds, until it represents your brand 100%.
We develop with clean code and modern technology: speed, SEO and flawless responsive from the ground up.
We publish, measure and optimize. Launch isn't the end: it's where growth begins.
